matches.description: Given a finite permutation group G and a prime p, compute the cohomology groups H^n(G, K) with trivial coefficients K = GF(p) using the unnormalized inhomogeneous bar complex. Each group reports betti = dim H^n(G, K) exactly; cochain_dimension is the ambient cochain space dimension |G|^n of the unnormalized cochains, not the cohomology dimension. H^0 = K always; higher groups measure extensions, crossed homomorphisms, and obstruction classes.
matches.title: Compute group cohomology with trivial coefficients over GF(p)

matches.description: For a nondegenerate integer lattice, return the discriminant order |det G| and the Smith invariant factors of L^*/L.
matches.title: Compute the discriminant group and pairing order

matches.description: Normalize two bounded integer-vector factors in a declared product of cyclic groups, exhaustively count every sum representation, and decide whether every group element has exactly one representation.
matches.title: Exact finite abelian group factorization

matches.description: Compute the complete cycle decomposition of one exact group element in a finite permutation action, including cycle partition, cycle lengths, cycle type as an integer partition of |X|, fixed-point set and count, and support set.
matches.title: Compute the cycle decomposition of one group element

matches.description: Compute the Galois group of a polynomial with rational coefficients using SymPy's galois_group function. The request must be irreducible and degree at most six; the result includes explicit generators.
matches.title: Compute the Galois group of a polynomial over Q
